tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The window and page ground: sidebar, wallet page, behind everything.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The reading surface: the meeting document, settings panes.

tokens.name: elevated
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces only: menu bar panel, sheets, popovers, the selected list row.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed fields: proof hash, recovery words, the transcript, input fills.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, raised, elevated and well (13:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, labels, evidence quotes, on every surface (5.0:1+).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Icons, meter tracks and decorative glyphs only (3.3:1+). Never text.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows and sections. Decorative; never a control's only edge.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons (3.2:1+ on ground and raised).

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: The only accent: the primary button, links, selection, Verified and Paid. Text on ground, raised and verdigris-tint (6.1:1+).

tokens.name: on-verdigris
tokens.usage: Label on a verdigris fill (7.4:1+).

tokens.name: verdigris-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of Verified and Paid pills and the selected sidebar row.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: Recording only (dot, timer, Stop) and Failed. Text on raised and record-tint (4.7:1+).

tokens.name: record-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the recording state and Failed pills.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: A person must look: Blocked payments, consent, silent audio. Text on raised and caution-tint (5.3:1+).

tokens.name: caution-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of Blocked and consent notices.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Meeting titles, onboarding and sheet headings. One per view.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: Summaries, decisions, the transcript: anything you read, not operate.
styles.sample: Ada and Victor agreed the API fix ships before Friday.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Evidence quotes from the transcript under a follow-up.
styles.sample: “pay the designer the fifty dollar deposit today”

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Row and panel titles, follow-up titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default interface text, buttons (600), list meta.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and pill text. Always muted or a status colour.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: NEAR accounts, amounts in rows, hashes, tx ids. Tabular figures.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: One headline number per view: balance, the recording timer.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; pill padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding; menu panel inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sidebar padding; between rows of follow-ups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between document sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Document side padding and the space above a display title.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows that need a container: the follow-up ledger, payee table.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: menu bar panel, sheets, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, the recording dot, meters.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only floating surfaces (menu bar panel, sheets). Nothing on the page casts a shadow.
